description: This file defines classes and objects for managing and posting Spark connect events related to query execution, including event tracking, status updates, and event classes for different stages of a connect operation.

classes.name: ExecuteStatus
classes.description: Enumeration of possible execution statuses for a connect operation.

classes.name: ExecuteEventsManager
classes.description: Class responsible for posting Spark connect events related to a specific execute request, tracking status, and managing event lifecycle.

classes.name: SparkListenerConnectOperationStarted
classes.description: Event indicating a connect operation has started.

classes.name: SparkListenerConnectOperationAnalyzed
classes.description: Event indicating a connect operation has been analyzed.

classes.name: SparkListenerConnectOperationReadyForExecution
classes.description: Event indicating a connect operation is ready for execution.

classes.name: SparkListenerConnectOperationCanceled
classes.description: Event indicating a connect operation has been canceled.

classes.name: SparkListenerConnectOperationFailed
classes.description: Event indicating a connect operation has failed.

classes.name: SparkListenerConnectOperationFinished
classes.description: Event indicating a connect operation has finished execution and results are available.

classes.name: SparkListenerConnectOperationClosed
classes.description: Event indicating a connect operation has been closed after completion.

methods.name: postStarted
methods.description: Posts an event indicating the start of a connect operation.

methods.name: postAnalyzed
methods.description: Posts an event indicating the connect operation has been analyzed.

methods.name: postReadyForExecution
methods.description: Posts an event indicating the connect operation is ready for execution.

methods.name: postCanceled
methods.description: Posts an event indicating the connect operation has been canceled.

methods.name: postFailed
methods.description: Posts an event indicating the connect operation has failed.

methods.name: postFinished
methods.description: Posts an event indicating the connect operation has finished execution.

methods.name: postClosed
methods.description: Posts an event indicating the connect operation has been closed.

methods.name: createQueryPlanningTracker
methods.description: Creates a QueryPlanningTracker that posts analysis and readiness events.

methods.name: assertStatus
methods.description: Checks if the current status is valid for a given event and updates status.
